points.definition: Central convex skin dome of the nose; exclude nostril opening and subnasale. Front pixel alone cannot establish its anterior maximum.
Outer skin margin of the nasal ala on front-image left; exclude inner nostril rim/shadow. Image side does not assert an anatomical left/right convention.
Outer skin margin of the nasal ala on front-image right; exclude inner nostril rim/shadow.
Junction of upper and lower lip at the front-image left commissure; distinguish actual skin/mucosa meeting point from makeup extension.
Junction of upper and lower lip at the front-image right commissure; distinguish actual skin/mucosa meeting point from makeup extension.
Anterior midline chin eminence on skin; not the lowest outline pixel (menton) or a view-dependent jaw contour. Requires profile/oblique semantic review.
